about:
Coherent is headquartered in Starkville, Mississippi. The company was founded in 1971 and has grown into a global photonics enterprise operating in more than 20 countries.

Coherent designs and manufactures lasers, optical components, and photonic systems for datacenter, communications, and industrial markets. Its product portfolio includes optical transceivers, active optical cables, silicon photonics devices, VCSEL arrays, and laser systems for precision manufacturing, semiconductor processing, and display fabrication. The company also supplies capital equipment for semiconductor and display production, such as excimer laser annealing and laser lift-off systems, and has announced the modernization and expansion of its Sherman facility with support from a proposed $50 million CHIPS Act award.

Customers span hyperscale datacenter operators, telecommunications network providers, automotive and energy manufacturers, semiconductor and display fabs, and research and medical institutions. Coherent's industrial lasers serve metal and plastic cutting, welding, marking, and ablation applications, while its instrumentation products support scientific research, OEM integration, and clinical settings. The company also provides photonic components for fusion energy research.

Coherent emphasizes its vertically integrated supply chain for datacom transceivers, combining silicon photonics, VCSELs, lenses, filters, and isolators to reduce supply chain uncertainty. The company cites its broad technology stack, global scale, and ISO-certified quality management as key differentiators, and has formed a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to develop optics technology for next-generation data center architecture.
